jobs.title: Director of Finance And Accounting
jobs.description:
Director, Accounting & Finance

Toronto, ON (Hybrid – Tuesdays and Thursdays in Toronto office)

$125,000–$150,000 base salary, plus benefits and RRSP matching

Our client is an established organization with a small Canadian team and long-tenured employees. They are looking for a Director, Accounting & Finance to take ownership of full-cycle accounting and financial reporting. Reporting to the Executive Director, you will supervise one direct report and work closely with finance colleagues across the broader organization.

This is a hands-on role for a CPA who enjoys preparing the numbers and explaining them to leadership. You will manage the monthly close, oversee payroll and help the team transition to Workday Financial and its integration with ADP. The organization is targeting a January 2027 start. They offer very good work/life balance, 12 sick days and an office closure between Christmas and New Year’s. Some weeks you will only be expected to go into the office one day per week, but mostly it will be two days. This is a very hands-on Director role, so you should be prepared to handle bank reconciliations, journal entries, HST filing and more.

Responsibilities

Manage the monthly and year-end close, including journal entries, general ledger reconciliations and the preparation of financial statements. Prepare monthly management reports and explain variances against budget.
Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable, manage day-to-day banking and complete bank reconciliations.
Record investment transactions, reconcile holdings to investment statements and prepare monthly investment reports. Review distribution approvals and complete the related accounting and reconciliations.
Oversee Ontario payroll through ADP. Review and approve each pay run, verify salary changes and ensure payroll information flows accurately between Workday and ADP.
Coordinate the annual audit, prepare working papers and financial schedules, and respond to questions from external auditors.
Prepare monthly GST/HST returns and coordinate withholding tax reporting, annual information returns and other regulatory filings with external advisers.
Review accounting policies, approval procedures and the segregation of duties. Help improve processes as the team transitions to new systems.
Supervise and develop one direct report whose current focus is accounts receivable. Help identify opportunities for that role to take on more financial analysis over time.

Requirements

Canadian CPA designation and a bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance or a related field.
At least eight years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for full-cycle accounting, bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.
Preference will be given to individuals with Workday and ADP experience.
Strong understanding of audit preparation, internal controls and payroll oversight.
Advanced EXCEL skills and the ability to investigate discrepancies, explain findings and manage competing deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment when handling confidential information and the ability to guide a direct report while managing your own accounting work.

If you are interested in learning more about this opportunity, please apply now. Unfortunately, due to the high volume of applicants, only those individuals chosen for interview will be contacted.

jobs.title: Director of Sales, Enterprise
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Sales, Enterprise based in Canada.

The Director of Sales, Enterprise will lead enterprise revenue growth across North America, driving new business acquisition and expanding relationships with strategic customers. This leadership role combines sales strategy, team development, and hands-on involvement in complex, high-value SaaS transactions. You will manage and coach a team of Account Executives while building a predictable, scalable enterprise sales engine. Working closely with senior executives and cross-functional teams, you will strengthen go-to-market execution and expand the organization's presence in the Life Sciences sector. The role requires strong commercial judgment, executive relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate lengthy, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. You will help shape enterprise sales performance in a fast-growing, innovative software environment.

Accountabilities

Drive enterprise revenue growth: Own and execute the North American enterprise sales strategy, achieving new business annual recurring revenue (ARR) targets and expanding market share across strategic accounts.
Develop sales strategy: Establish structured approaches for complex enterprise sales cycles, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, and deal execution.
Lead and develop the sales team: Manage, mentor, and coach Account Executives through hands-on guidance, performance management, and ongoing professional development.
Support strategic deals: Engage directly in high-value opportunities, helping the team develop deal strategies, build executive relationships, navigate procurement, negotiate commercial terms, and close business.
Build executive relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with senior decision-makers across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device organizations in the United States and Canada.
Manage pipeline and performance: Maintain a healthy enterprise pipeline, monitor sales metrics, and identify ways to improve conversion rates, deal progression, and overall sales effectiveness.
Expand market opportunities: Identify and pursue new enterprise accounts across North America, developing targeted strategies and strengthening market positioning within the Life Sciences industry.
Collaborate across departments: Work closely with Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Revenue Operations to align go-to-market initiatives and address complex customer needs.
Oversee forecasting and reporting: Lead pipeline reviews, revenue forecasting, and sales reporting, providing senior leadership with visibility into opportunities, risks, and expected performance.

Requirements

8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, with a focus on enterprise accounts.
At least 3 years of experience in sales management or leadership, including managing, coaching, and developing Account Executives.
Proven record of achieving and exceeding enterprise sales targets in North American and global markets, including closing complex, high-value SaaS deals.
Experience selling SaaS solutions to Life Sciences organizations or within Quality Management, Compliance, or other highly regulated industries.
Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device sectors, including international regulatory and compliance requirements such as FDA, EMA, and GxP.
Extensive knowledge of complex enterprise sales cycles, including multi-stakeholder decision-making, executive-level engagement, procurement, and contract negotiations.
Strong business acumen and the ability to communicate technical capabilities in terms of measurable business value to C-level executives and senior decision-makers.
Hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to guide teams through discovery, qualification, value-based selling, negotiation, and closing.
Strong analytical skills and experience with revenue forecasting, pipeline management, and sales performance metrics.
Ability to balance strategic planning with direct sales involvement in a dynamic, fast-growing environment.
Availability to work primarily Eastern Time (ET) hours to collaborate effectively with internal teams.
Nice to have: Experience selling Quality Management Systems (QMS) or compliance software; experience scaling enterprise sales teams and processes in early- to mid-stage SaaS companies; familiarity with Salesforce-native SaaS products and go-to-market environments.

Benefits

The source job posting does not specify a salary range or detailed benefits package.
Full-time position with a remote work arrangement across North America.
Opportunity to lead enterprise sales strategy and develop a high-performing Account Executive team.
Exposure to strategic customers in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device industries.
Opportunity to contribute to the growth of innovative cloud-based SaaS solutions in the Life Sciences sector.
Inclusive work environment committed to equal opportunity and diversity.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.
